Issue #382 and part of #384 (the pasted-key bullet): step 4 reads the Literal First Run block from the installed traigent-setup-quickstart directory (the skills may not be loaded in this session yet; prefer the copy step 1 installed, else the newest installed copy, over a marketplace checkout); the pasted-key bullet is an allowlist gate whose numbered sub-steps must each positively pass before the key is stored: a symlinked .env (even a broken one) is a stop checked before .env is created, then .env must be a regular file; mode 0600 on macOS/Linux; the repository status is confirmed with LC_ALL=C git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree, where only the exact 'fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git' message skips the git checks and any other result stops; inside a repo, .env is untracked and git-ignored, judged by exit code. A failed gate skips the key write and setup continues to the keyless step 4, with the summary box's pending TRAIGENT_API_KEY line.
Use the adjacent .env ignore rule in both key-entry flows, matching setup-quickstart; keep keyless verification available on refusal.
